chreece.dataset: Author recordings; fine-tuned from lessac/high per model card

settings.loudness: -20 LUFS target, -4 dBTP ceiling before encoding
settings.trim: edge amplitude > .008; 20 ms lead, 50 ms tail
settings.duration: .5–2.48 seconds; long speech time-compressed, never word-truncated
settings.police-megaphone-v1: After pitch/time processing: highpass 420 Hz, lowpass 3200 Hz, tanh soft clip threshold .12/output .85, highpass 350 Hz; then original -20 LUFS/-4 dBTP normalization and fades.
